usage: The word "木" is a noun that refers to wood, the material from trees.
It can be used to describe the material used to make furniture or buildings.
木 often appears in compound words with other characters to specify types or uses of wood.
In everyday speech, 木 can describe anything made from wood or associated with wood.
The word 木 is also used metaphorically to describe someone or something stiff or unresponsive.
